question: Padma Bhushan awardee Uma Sharma is a ______ dancer.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uma Sharma** 

 
 
• **Uma Sharma **is a famous **Indian Kathak dancer**.
 
• In the **city of Delhi**, Uma Sharma was born in **1942**.
 
• She was trained in dance by **Guru Hiralalji and Girvar Dayal **of the** Jaipur Gharana** in her early years.
 
• She **afterward enrolled as Pandit Sunder Prasad's** student in the Jaipur Gharana.
 
• In **1973**, she became the** youngest dancer** to receive the **Padma Shri award** from the Government of India, and in **2001**, she received the **Padma Bhushan**.
 
• She also received the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award and the Sahitya Kala Parishad Award**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• She received the **title Srijan Manishi on January 27, 2013**, from the **Akhil Bhartiya Vikram Parishad in Kashi **in recognition of her significant contribution to** Indian Kathak dance**.
 
• The **dance style Kathak** is primarily based on court poetry from the **18th and 19th centuries**, which glorified **shringara**, the sense of love, as well as devotional and **spiritual Krishna poetry** from medieval times.
 
• **Birju Maharaj, Sitara Devi, Shambhu Maharaj, Damayanti Joshi, Shovana Narayan, Uma Sharma, and Shobha Koser **are some of the most well-known Kathak dancers.
